subproblem.title: Mass bound for the competitor Z + f_#X when f fixes Z on G and Y = Z + X
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, G ⊆ ℝ^P open with G ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained G U: closure G is compact and contained in U), O ⊆ ℝ^P open with G ⊆ O, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O, and Λ ≥ 0 with ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ G (Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, operator norm). Let RZ = (M_Z, θ_Z, ξ_Z), RX = (M_X, θ_X, ξ_X) and RY = (M_Y, θ_Y, ξ_Y) be integer multiplicity triples in U (IMRep U n) and Y, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U), and write τ(R)(ω) := R.action ω = ∫_{M_R} θ_R ξ_R(ω) dHⁿ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Assume: RY represents Y; Y(ω) = τ(RZ)(ω) + τ(RX)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_Z ∩ G (i.e. Hⁿ⌞(M_Z ∩ G)-a.e.), f(x) = x and ξ_Z(x)(α∘Df(x)) = ξ_Z(x)(α) for every n-covector α; Hⁿ(M_X ∖ G) = 0; and S(ω) = τ(RZ)(ω) + ∫_{M_X} θ_X(x)·ξ_X(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then M_G(S) ≤ Λⁿ·μ_{RY}(G), i.e. S.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(Λⁿ)·RY.measure G, where M_G(S) is the supremum of S(ω) over ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with spt ω ⊆ G and |ω(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z (Simon 6.2.5, Euclidean coefficient norm) and μ_{RY} = θ_Y·Hⁿ⌞M_Y.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G O : Set (Euclid P)) (RZ RX RY : IMRep U n) (Y S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen G → CompactlyContained G U → IsOpen O → G ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ x ∈ G, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → RY.Represents Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + RX.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (RZ.carrier ∩ G)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, RZ.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = RZ.orient x α) → μHE[n] (RX.carrier \ G) = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + ∫ x in RX.carrier, (RX.mult x : ℝ) * RX.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → S.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Λ ^ n) * RY.measure G
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 7 of the parent proof, i.e. the competitor mass bound in Simon's proof of 7.2.4, (8)–(9) (chapter-07.txt lines 222–246), for the competitor S = Z + f_#X with f fixing Z on G. The vector-measure identity of the parent's step 7(c) is obtained from three accepted DAG declarations.
Notation. Hⁿ := μHE[n]. For an IMRep R = (M_R, θ_R, ξ_R) put ν_R(x) := 1_{M_R}(x)·θ_R(x)·ξ_R(x) ∈ Λ_n (MultiVector P n), τ(R)(ω) := R.action ω = ∫_{M_R} θ_R ξ_R(ω) dHⁿ, and μ_R := R.measure = θ_R·Hⁿ⌞M_R. Write RZ = (M_Z, θ_Z, ξ_Z), RX = (M_X, θ_X, ξ_X), RY = (M_Y, θ_Y, ξ_Y). Ḡ := closure G is a compact subset of U (CompactlyContained G U). Df(x) := fderiv ℝ f x; ‖·‖ operator norms; |·|_E := covectorEuclideanNorm.
1. Vector density identity. (a) The accepted sibling rsdic_exists_imrep_int_combination (U open, p₁ = p₂ = 1) gives an IMRep R in U with ν_R = ν_{RZ} + ν_{RX} Hⁿ-a.e. on ℝ^P. (b) The accepted sibling rsdic_imrep_action_int_combination turns (a) into R.action ω = τ(RZ)(ω) + τ(RX)(ω) = Y(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U); thus R represents Y. (c) RY also represents Y, so the accepted sibling imrep_weighted_orient_indicator_ae_eq gives ν_R = ν_{RY} Hⁿ-a.e. on M_R ∪ M_Y. (d) Outside M_R ∪ M_Y both ν_R and ν_{RY} vanish. Combining (a), (c) and (d): ν_{RY} = ν_{RZ} + ν_{RX} Hⁿ-a.e. on ℝ^P.
2. An admissible form and its pull-back. Let ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) be admissible for S.massOn G: tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z. Put φ(x) := ω(f(x))∘Df(x) for x ∈ G and φ(x) := 0 for x ∉ G. As f and Df are continuous on the open set O ⊇ G (f is C¹ on O), φ is continuous on the open set G, hence Borel on ℝ^P. Moreover ‖φ(x)‖ ≤ ‖ω‖_∞·Λⁿ for all x (‖β∘L‖ ≤ ‖β‖‖L‖ⁿ, ‖Df‖ ≤ Λ on G), and φ = 0 off G ⊆ Ḡ.
3. Integrability. For R ∈ {RZ, RX, RY}: for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_R, ξ_R(x) is a unit orientation (R.orients), so |ξ_R(x)(β)| ≤ ‖β‖. Hence x ↦ ν_R(x)(φ(x)) is a.e.-strongly measurable, vanishes off M_R ∩ Ḡ, and is bounded by ‖ω‖_∞Λⁿ·θ_R(x)·1_{M_R∩Ḡ}(x); since ∫_{M_R∩Ḡ} θ_R dHⁿ < ∞ (R.locallyIntegrable_mult), it is Hⁿ-integrable. In the same way x ↦ θ_Z(x)ξ_Z(x)(ω(x)) is integrable on M_Z (tsupport ω ⊆ Ḡ), and x ↦ θ_X(x)ξ_X(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) is integrable on M_X, as it agrees Hⁿ⌞M_X-a.e. with ν_{RX}(φ) (step 5).
4. The Z part. τ(RZ)(ω) = ∫ ν_{RZ}(φ) dHⁿ. Indeed, for x ∈ M_Z ∖ G we have x ∉ tsupport ω, so ω(x) = 0 = φ(x). M_Z ∩ G is Borel, so the hypothesis on Hⁿ⌞(M_Z ∩ G) says: for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_Z ∩ G, f(x) = x and ξ_Z(x)(α∘Df(x)) = ξ_Z(x)(α) for all α. For such x, φ(x) = ω(x)∘Df(x), and with α := ω(x), ξ_Z(x)(φ(x)) = ξ_Z(x)(ω(x)). So the integrands of τ(RZ)(ω) = ∫_{M_Z} θ_Zξ_Z(ω) dHⁿ and ∫ ν_{RZ}(φ) dHⁿ agree Hⁿ-a.e.
5. The X part. ∫_{M_X} θ_X(x)ξ_X(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫ ν_{RX}(φ) dHⁿ, since the integrands agree on M_X ∩ G and Hⁿ(M_X ∖ G) = 0.
6. The Y part. By the hypothesis on S, steps 4–5, linearity of the integral (step 3) and step 1: S(ω) = ∫ (ν_{RZ} + ν_{RX})(x)(φ(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫ ν_{RY}(x)(φ(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫_{M_Y∩G} θ_Y(x)·ξ_Y(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x).
7. Pointwise bound. For Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_Y, ξ_Y(x) is a unit orientation of some n-plane. For such x ∈ G, the sibling dor_lmb_pc_unitOrientation_comp, part (a), with α := ω(f(x)) and L := Df(x), gives |ξ_Y(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x))| ≤ |ω(f(x))|_E·‖Df(x)‖ⁿ ≤ 1·Λⁿ.
8. Conclusion. By steps 6–7, S(ω) ≤ Λⁿ∫_{M_Y∩G} θ_Y dHⁿ = Λⁿ·(μ_{RY}(G)).toReal, where μ_{RY}(G) ≤ μ_{RY}(Ḡ) < ∞. Hence ofReal(S(ω)) ≤ ofReal(Λⁿ)·μ_{RY}(G) (Λ ≥ 0). S.massOn G is the supremum of ofReal(S(ω)) over the admissible ω (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.massOn), so S.massOn G ≤ ofReal(Λⁿ)·RY.measure G. ∎
proof_key_steps: Three accepted lemmas give the vector-density identity 1_{M_Y}θ_Yξ_Y = 1_{M_Z}θ_Zξ_Z + 1_{M_X}θ_Xξ_X Hⁿ-a.e.
For admissible ω, the bounded Borel form φ = 1_G·ω(f)∘Df represents both parts: f fixes Z a.e. on M_Z ∩ G, and M_X ⊆ G a.e.
Hence S(ω) = ∫_{M_Y∩G} θ_Yξ_Y(ω(f)∘Df) dHⁿ, all integrands being dominated on the compact closure of G.
Part (a) of dor_lmb_pc_unitOrientation_comp bounds |ξ_Y(ω(f)∘Df)| ≤ Λⁿ on G, so S(ω) ≤ Λⁿμ_{RY}(G); take the supremum.

audit.reason: The three declared representation lemmas establish the global almost-everywhere vector-density identity. Compact domination justifies evaluation against the bounded Borel pullback. The fixed-Z and carried-X hypotheses identify S's action, and orient_comp gives the exact ENNReal supremum bound.
